cohort: The study included 964 singleton pregnancies (241 cases with LGA at birth, 723 controls without) that underwent ultrasound examination at 11 + 0 to 13 + 6 weeks for aneuploidy screening at a single center.
finding: Umbilical vein blood flow (UVBF) measured at 11-14 weeks of gestation is independently associated with and predictive of large-for-gestational-age (LGA) at birth and birth weight > 4000 g, and its addition improves the diagnostic accuracy of a multiparametric prenatal screening model.
birth_weight: Cases: > 90th centile for gestational age and sex; Controls: 10th-90th centile for gestational age and sex; outcome also included BW > 4000 g.
gest_age: Ultrasound performed at 11 + 0 to 13 + 6 weeks of gestation; LGA defined based on gestational age.
